hypothesisMarkdown:
## List Immutable Groups Check Only Touched Groups For Emptiness Hypothesis

### Hypothesis

`ImmutableListGroupState::retain_non_empty_groups` collects the group key of every entry into a `HashSet` (cloning and hashing n keys) on every batch to drop emptied groups. Only a group the batch touched can have become empty (every insert, removal, regroup or clear captures its group), so scanning the entries only until each touched group has been seen once — usually a handful of entries — finds the emptied groups with the same result.

### Scope Lock

**Tested mechanism:** emptiness check restricted to touched groups, with an early-exit scan.
**Allowed changes:** `retain_non_empty_groups` and its two call sites in `crates/src/collections/operators/list_pending_group_changes.rs` (list immutable groups).
**Forbidden in this experiment:** group snapshots, per-group member indexes, the cache immutable group.
measurementPlanMarkdown:

~15-25% off immutable group updates (four O(n) snapshot scans remain).
